items.title: Kuwait releases CCTV footage of deadly Iranian strike on airport
items.description: Kuwait has released surveillance footage of what it says shows an Iranian drone strike on Kuwait International Airport.

items.title: Why the French Catholic Church is against lifting the seal of confession
items.description: Lawmakers on June 1 removed an article which would have required priests to report sexual crimes against minors that they learned of in confession, from the bill to 'protect children and combat violence in schools.'

items.title: Growing up with sirens: UN child rights envoy on the toll of the Ukraine-Russia war
items.description: Children in Ukraine have been profoundly impacted by years of war, sheltering in underground schools – or forced to study online – and living with the psychological strain of constant air raid sirens that could spell death for them and their families.

items.title: Democracy in Africa: Coups, crises and foregone conclusions
items.description: As Ethiopia formally counts the votes following Monday's election, attitudes toward democracy appear to be shifting across Africa. In April, Burkina Faso's junta leader told the Burkinabe people to "forget" democracy.

items.title: Iran war soured Gulf Arabs on Iraq. Can new leader in Baghdad win them back?
items.description: Iraq was offering attractive opportunities for Gulf Arab economic and diplomatic initiatives, but the war made it a springboard for Iran-backed militia attacks. Can the country’s young and untested prime minister navigate a multifaceted crisis?

items.title: How This Russian Nuclear Waste Dump Became an Unlikely Victim of the Ukraine War
items.description: Europe poured millions into cleaning up a hazardous nuclear waste site in Russia's Arctic. The invasion of Ukraine brought the effort to a halt.

items.title: Russian attack on Ukraine kills 22 people, officials say, as Moscow escalates fighting
items.description: Russian forces launched a massive aerial attack on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, and officials say at least 22 civilians were killed and 138 were wounded. The assault began overnight and continued during the day.
